figures.finding: Sarajevo is the capital, by the constitution; no source counting where screen work is made was found.

sources.said: The capital of Bosnia and Herzegovina shall be Sarajevo.

figures.finding: Bosnia and Herzegovina's film actors join the Association of Filmmakers of BiH (Udruženje filmskih radnika BiH, Sarajevo, founded 1950), a professional association of people engaged in filmmaking that has taken film actors as members since March 2016; it publishes no rate card.

value.union: Udruženje filmskih radnika u Bosni i Hercegovini (Association of Filmmakers of BiH)

figures.applies: Bosnia and Herzegovina, film actors, from March 2016.

sources.said: The Association of Filmmakers of Bosnia and Herzegovina is a professional association which gathers filmmakers, who are professionally engaged in filmmaking and was founded in 1950. … since March 2016 accepts film actors in its membership.

figures.finding: In the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina the official languages are Bosnian, Croatian and Serbian, in Latin and Cyrillic script (Amendment XXIX to the Federation's constitution, replacing the 1994 text that named Bosnian and Croatian only); no source names the language film is made in.

value.instrument: Ustav FBiH, Amandman XXIX (amends art. I.6)

figures.applies: Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina (not Republika Srpska), current constitution text.

sources.said: AMANDMAN XXIX (1) Službeni jezici Federacije Bosne i Hercegovine su: bosanski jezik, hrvatski jezik i srpski jezik. Službena pisma su latinica i ćirilica. (2) Ostali jezici mogu se koristiti kao sredstvo komunikacije i nastave. Ovim amandmanom mijenja se član I.6. Ustava Federacije Bosne i Hercegovine
